articles.title: Zoom Past Traffic: The Coolest Electric Scooters We Tested!
articles.summary: Forget parking headaches! We zipped around on electric scooters to find the best ones. The Segway Ninebot Max can go 40 miles on one charge—that's like riding from school to the beach and back!

articles.title: The Sleeping Sickness Mystery: Why Did Thousands Suddenly Fall Asleep?
articles.summary: A hundred years ago, a strange disease made people sleep for weeks—or even months. It killed 500,000 people, and scientists still don't know what caused it. Could it come back?

articles.title: Shakira Says 'No Way!' to Fake Campaign Pics
articles.summary: Someone made fake pictures of Shakira supporting a presidential candidate in Colombia. She quickly said, "Those are fake! I don't support anyone." She just wants fair elections.
